profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Tiger Connect
profile.summary: As a seasoned Senior Software Engineer with expertise in .Net and C#, I pride myself on being a proactive and responsible professional who embraces challenges and continuous growth. My greatest strength lies in my ability to learn quickly and apply my knowledge effectively. In my previous role, I successfully led a development team while remaining hands-on in writing code. I have extensive experience collaborating with international teams, including developers, leaders, and product owners, and communicating effectively in English. My goal is to continue expanding my skill set, exploring new technologies, and gaining valuable experience to further enhance my expertise.
